summary: User repeating request—previous attempt to open mocks failed
detailed_context: The previous response claimed 'Mock opened in your default browser' but the user is immediately re-requesting the same action. This indicates the mock either didn't actually open, or opened incorrectly/invisibly. The terse, direct repeat without any other context signals frustration—the user expected the task to be complete. This is a failed delivery on a straightforward task, requiring the user to follow up. Key lesson: verify file operations actually succeeded before claiming completion.
